name: Jaehong Kim
evidence: No address retrieved; "Jaehong Kim" is a high-collision Korean name and every email-bearing hit failed the namesake test. GitHub code search for "Jaehong Kim" + kaist.ac.kr returned 11k+ hits, of which the ones printing an address belong to different Jaehong Kims: jaehong950305@gmail.com in kaist-ina/NAS_demo (video-streaming systems, Dongsu Han's lab), jhong3842@gmail.com in KAIST-IS521/2017ctf-writeups (security CTF), mixe@korea.com in Django's Korean locale file, and a third Jaehong Kim listed as a 2023 CASYS-lab PhD graduate on jaehyuk-huh.github.io. None of these is the computational-social-science / moral-cognition Jaehong Kim. The correct person is confirmed on https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hikoseon12/hikoseon12.github.io/main/content.js (Jiseon Kim's site), which lists "Jiseon Kim, Jea Kwon, Luiz Felipe Vecchietti, Wenchao Dong, Jaehong Kim, Meeyoung Cha -- Exploring LLM Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas, Findings of ACL 2026" = the target arXiv 2604.21871, but that file prints only jiseon_kim@kaist.ac.kr, the first author's. "Jaehong Kim" + ibs.re.kr returned 0. One WebSearch (name + KAIST + Institute for Basic Science + Meeyoung Cha) returned only a Google Scholar profile (scholar.google.co.kr/citations?user=aMHLQmEAAAAJ, interests: moral emotion, attention economy -- the right person) and no address; Google Scholar's "verified email at" is not an address and scholar.google.com is blocked anyway. His LinkedIn (kr.linkedin.com/in/jaehong-kim-1b3601202) is also blocked by the container egress policy.
